title: Group Anagram Signatures

monster.name: Permutation Gorgon
monster.title: Weaver of Shuffled Syllables
monster.defeatQuote: My scrambled letters were indexed by their canonical sorts!

description: Given an array of strings `strs`, group the anagrams together. Return the groups sorted by group size, and lexicographically within each group.
constraints: strs[i] consists of lowercase English letters
solutionCode:
def groupAnagramsCanonical(strs: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:
    from collections import defaultdict
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for s in strs:
        key = ''.join(sorted(s))
        groups[key].append(s)
    res = [sorted(g) for g in groups.values()]
    res.sort(key=lambda x: (len(x), x[0] if x else ''))
    return res
